method: Current production renderer + local shipped signed source data + deterministic DOM lifecycle/geometry; no browser layout, performance or computed-style claim.

results.name: Never-opened originals remain cold across language, export, pagination and phase return
Language switch reuses exact original DOM, selected chapter, provenance, paragraph position and internal focus
Both export renders retain the original view and do not steal focus from download controls
142-row phase pagination and Mali to Ming to Mali retain only the same card state
Two Mali cards share source identity but keep independent open and paragraph positions
Language switch while original fetch is pending, then another card, blocks stale DOM and focus writes
Closed surrounding details survives language rebuild and reopens at the saved paragraph
Outer collapse during fetch plus language rebuild postpones late text until the new outer guide opens
Destroy during original fetch leaves no body, focus or host writes after late completion
Registry restores source paragraph plus block offset after reflow and after LRU recreation
Native scroll reset after DOM reattachment cannot overwrite the saved paragraph before rapid second render
LRU eviction during an unrestored reattachment keeps the previous source-block snapshot
Snapshots require exact card, original source and derived-document identity before reopening
Width reflow preserves the actual source paragraph and character within a long paragraph without changing focus or contents
Repeated width changes and native programmatic scroll events keep the same character anchor without cumulative line drift
Native scroll arriving before ResizeObserver cannot replace the previous-layout text anchor
Several width changes coalesce into one restoration using the final geometry
A contents selection supersedes pending automatic restoration and keeps its intended focus
A related-passage button supersedes pending resize restoration
Wheel, touch, scrollbar pointer and scroll keys supersede a pending resize restore
Input arriving before ResizeObserver respects the user-selected new position
Unrelated or already handled keys leave the queued resize restoration intact
Closing and reopening the source while resize is queued retains its character and reconnects one observer
A hidden surrounding guide can change width without recording zero geometry or stealing outside focus
Language reattachment during queued resize keeps the exact source character and original DOM
Destroy invalidates queued frames, disconnects observation and blocks a late observer delivery
Viewport-height-only changes keep the paragraph position
Without DOM Range, live reflow keeps a proportional paragraph offset and original registry semantics still work
Without ResizeObserver, the window-resize fallback restores position and removes listeners on destruction
Selecting a section before the first restore frame still starts resize observation
User scrolling before the reattachment restore reconnects observation and supersedes saved position
At the end of a document, viewport growth accepts native clamping and saves the achievable position for the next resize
An empty Range rectangle falls back to the same source paragraph instead of inventing a character position
Rapid repeated language reattachment cannot let old frames overwrite a later explicit directory choice
